Maya (sales-eng): ACME POC stuck: SCIM group sync failing after customer rotated SAML certs. They use Okta + Azure AD. Need fix before EOD demo.
Sam (solutions): Can you share the SCIM response and any SAML errors?
Maya (sales-eng): SCIM responses: POST /scim/v2/Users 403 Forbidden - "SCIM provisioning disabled for tenant due to assertion mismatch". SAML logs show signature verify failed + unexpected RelayState after cert rotate.
Ben (security): 403 suggests either SCIM token revoked/invalid or SSO gateway refused assertions because cert fingerprint changed. Did they upload new SP metadata to both IDPs?
Maya (sales-eng): They say yes, metadata uploaded. They rotate certs during maintenance window which probably caused a timing gap.
Priya (ops): For POCs we can enable a short-term fallback: allow previous cert fingerprint in the sso-proxy for N minutes and issue a time-limited Hosted API key with scim:write scope. Need ops+security signoff.
Sam (solutions): Temp key would let them push user/group objects directly while they finish IDP fixes. Less risky than changing Dedicated/VPC.
Ben (security): Conditions: 1) TTL 4 hours, 2) audit annotation with customer request ID, 3) immediate revoke on suspicion. Also confirm customer uploaded both old+new cert fingerprints.
Priya (ops): I can create key "poc-temp-scim-key" with 4h TTL and enable a 2h dual-cert window for tenant acme-poc. I'll create audit ticket and collect approvals.
OpsBot: Action: applied sso-proxy dual-cert config for tenant acme-poc at 1999601500.
Maya (sales-eng): Sent secure DM to customer with temp key and usage snippet. They retried SCIM and report success for group sync.
Sam (solutions): Follow-ups: Sam to send runbook + expiration reminder; Priya to remove dual-cert window after expiry; Ben to verify audit logs; Maya to collect Dedicated trial interest & pricing ask.
Maya (sales-eng): Demo confirmed on schedule. Will reopen if anything else shows up. :thumbsup:
